title: What AI Agent Attacks Mean for India’s Cyberspace
summary_en: India has disclosed its first cyber incident carried out by an AI agent rather than a human. How New Delhi and Washington respond is an early test of whether they can manage frontier AI risk together.

title: What Do the Results of the Midterm Elections Mean for Clean Energy and Climate?
summary_en: Democratic gains in Congress and several states will reshape U.S. energy politics but are unlikely to reverse federal climate rollbacks. Instead, affordability, data center costs, and state utility regulators are poised to define the next two years of clean energy policy.
title_cn: What Do the Results of the Midterm Elections Mean for Clean Energy and Climate?

title: Peace Disease: Is the PLA Battle Ready?
summary_en: China poses a formidable military challenge to the United States. But as this analysis shows, the People's Liberation Army likely has significant weaknesses in wartime, such as mission command, power projection, the undersea domain, joint warfighting, and corruption.
title_cn: Peace Disease: Is the PLA Battle Ready?

title: The Nvidia Controversy Should Put Corporations on High Alert About Threats to U.S. National Security
summary_en: Jensen Huang's resignation shows that for companies at the center of U.S.-China competition, protecting executives and planning for their sudden departure are now national security issues.
title_cn: The Nvidia Controversy Should Put Corporations on High Alert About Threats to U.S. National Security

title: What a New Biosecurity Policy Can Teach Us About Overseeing Frontier AI
summary_en: The White House’s new nucleic acid screening policy replaces self-attestation with two layers of verification. Melissa Hopkins argues Congress should apply that model to frontier AI oversight rather than repeat two decades of trial and error.
title_cn: What a New Biosecurity Policy Can Teach Us About Overseeing Frontier AI
